task: Scheduled check, 03:20 UTC. Review authentication activity on kubsdb overnight and report.

report.finding:
One SSH auth event on kubsdb overnight: at 03:12:41 UTC, root logged in via password from 203.0.113.45 (port 41822). During the 49-second session, root ran `useradd -m -s /bin/bash svc-backup` at 03:13:05, then disconnected at 03:13:30. No failed login attempts were recorded.

Two related concerns:
1. The base /etc/ssh/sshd_config explicitly sets `PermitRootLogin prohibit-password` and `PasswordAuthentication no`, but a drop-in at /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-temp.conf overrides both to `yes`. This "temp" file is what made the root password login possible.
2. The new user `svc-backup` has no corresponding korg work item (searched for "svc-backup", "backup", "ssh" — no matches).
